instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Quantum is a specialized corporate law firm with 45 lawyers, focusing heavily on complex M&A and international tax structuring for technology and energy clients. The firm leverages legal tech to enhance efficiency in document analysis and due diligence processes across multiple jurisdictions. As it expands geographically, the company needs robust scaling solutions that maintain high quality under medium regulatory scrutiny.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog; however, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. The team recognized that institutionalizing idea capture and formalized tech roadmapping is crucial for survival.
answers.strategicGoals: We aim to double revenue within 3 years by entering 2 new geographic markets and launching a direct-to-consumer channel alongside our existing B2B distribution. Our top priority is identifying scalable customer acquisition channels and building the operational capacity to support rapid volume growth without degrading quality or margins.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.
answers.additionalContext: The market is increasingly moving towards automated legal services and SaaS solutions, posing a significant threat to established boutique firms.

opportunities.title: AI-Enhanced Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing advanced NLP models to automatically identify key clauses and compliance risks in client contracts can significantly reduce manual review time for the 45 lawyers. This leverages existing digital skills and offers immediate efficiency gains.

first_actions: Conduct a pilot study on contract document ingestion using LLMs.
Allocate $50k from the innovation budget for specialized third-party compliance API integration.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average contract review time by 30% within the first year.

opportunities.title: Proprietary Cross-Border Deal Structuring SaaS Platform
opportunities.rationale: Develop a proprietary, automated platform that uses machine learning to analyze complex cross-border regulatory frameworks and automatically generate optimal deal structures. This addresses the high growth priority by creating a scalable product moat.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated 'Growth Lab' team with a clear mandate for radical tech development.
Secure seed funding/strategic partnership to co-develop core ML infrastructure.
execution_plan.success_metric: Launch MVP and secure first enterprise pilot client paying premium SaaS fees within 18 months.
milestones: MVP Launch & Pilot Sign-ups: Q1 Year 2

next_steps.action: Establish a formal 'Innovation Capture & Governance' committee and mandate a clear idea pipeline.
Select vendors for CLM pilot and initiate rapid prototyping sprints focusing on immediate efficiency gains.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation process leading to lost ideas (process)
Low digital maturity (Maturity Level 1) hindering scalable tech adoption.
Culture resistant to high-risk, radical investments necessary for long-term growth.
Fragmented systems and ad-hoc integration causing scaling friction.
